title: Two Boys at Outdoor Catholic Shrine, 1954 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot dated June 13, 1954, depicting two young boys identified as Gary and Bobby standing and kneeling in front of an elaborate outdoor Marian shrine. The setup includes a decorated Catholic altar with white lattice fencing, flowers, a statue of the Virgin Mary, and a kneeling saint figure on the left side, representing mid-20th-century American Catholic family devotional life.
